about: Known answers for Scout's accuracy eval. Only expectations listed under 'expect' are scored; leave a field out when its answer isn't known. Provenance: 'verified' answers were confirmed against the live source on the date given; 'believed' ones are well known but await confirmation by a live run. Real companies change job boards and websites, so a mismatch is either a bug or a stale answer: check which before changing either.

companies.name: GitLab
companies.note: Wikidata lists the site as about.gitlab.com (found via the redirect) but has no GitHub account for GitLab, and gitlab.com doesn't link its GitHub mirror org (gitlabhq): a known miss, since GitLab's code lives on gitlab.com.
